description: This file contains the implementation of a parser for GN build files, including token parsing, syntax tree construction, and comment assignment.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A recursive descent parser implementing expression parsing, statement handling, and comment assignment for GN build files.

classes.name: ParseNode
classes.description: Base class for all syntax tree nodes.

classes.name: LiteralNode
classes.description: Represents a literal value (integer, string, boolean).

classes.name: IdentifierNode
classes.description: Represents an identifier (variable or function name).

classes.name: FunctionCallNode
classes.description: Represents a function call with arguments and optional block.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents scope or array access expressions.

classes.name: BlockNode
classes.description: Represents a block of statements, such as function bodies or conditional branches.

classes.name: UnaryOpNode
classes.description: Represents a unary operation (e.g., logical NOT).

classes.name: BinaryOpNode
classes.description: Represents a binary operation (e.g., addition, comparison).

classes.name: EndNode
classes.description: Represents the end position of a syntax element.

classes.name: BlockCommentNode
classes.description: Represents a block comment in the source code.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse a list of tokens into a syntax tree.

methods.name: ParseExpression
methods.description: Parses an expression with operator precedence.

methods.name: ParseFile
methods.description: Parses the entire source file into a syntax tree.

methods.name: ParseStatement
methods.description: Parses a single statement or expression.

methods.name: ParseBlock
methods.description: Parses a block of statements enclosed in braces.

methods.name: AssignComments
methods.description: Assigns comments to syntax nodes based on position.
